changes: SYNC WELL WITHIN THE NEW API LIMITS (v11.101 / v11.102): a normal sync check uses 4 Intervals.icu requests, well inside Intervals.icu's new limit of 8,000 a day. Local sync checks every minute by default; choose 1, 2, 5 or 10 minutes with check_interval_minutes in .sync_config.json (about 5,800, 2,900, 1,200 or 600 requests a day), useful if other tools use the same key. Section 11 is capped at 7,000 requests a day, so at least 1,000 always stay free for other tools; if it gets close, sync slows itself down instead. GitHub sync runs every 30 minutes by default, to stay within GitHub's free Actions minutes for private repositories, and On-demand runs when you ask; both use 4 requests on a quiet run.

VERIFIED RELEASES AND UPDATES (v11.103): Section 11 now ships as dated, verified releases (section11-YYYY.MM.DD), and every setup has the same layout: the official files in section11/, with your data, DOSSIER.md and custom/ folder beside it. Each install keeps section11/ exactly as released and removes files elsewhere in the folder named exactly like Section 11 files, including the old root sync.py, push.py and pull.py; custom/, the dossier and your data are never touched. Updates are checked once a day, and your AI mentions a short notice from latest.json when an update or the one-time upgrade is due. Local sync and Manual export: the installer sets up the standard auto sync timer (choose --no-timer to run by hand); you confirm each update with --update, or set "auto_update": true for fully automatic updates; --rollback restores the previous installation. GitHub and On-demand sync: one sync workflow with Sync, Update, Status and Rollback; updates are committed directly, with no pull requests; set the repository variable SECTION11_AUTO_UPDATE=true for fully automatic updates. Guide: examples/maintenance/UPDATING.md. Demo with fictional data: https://github.com/CrankAddict/section-11-demo

ROUTE WEATHER (v11.78 to v11.82): wind, gusts, rain and temperature along planned routes, timed by your own riding pace, with weather maps and a weather report. On by default; turn off with "route_weather": false or SECTION11_ROUTE_WEATHER=0.
CLIMBS (v11.76 / v11.77): new climb detection for routes and outdoor rides, 42 of 45 Garmin climbs matched on unseen rides.
REPORTS (v11.81 / v11.84 / v11.100): truly rolling 7-day and 28-day reports (asking for weekly or block still works), a refreshed post-workout report and a phone-friendly layout for all reports.

SESSION STRUCTURE + COMPLIANCE (v11.75 / v11.87 / v11.90 / v11.93): executed session structure and step compliance for structured workouts, including short reps and sprints. latest.json interval_data replaces structure_summary.
MULTI-SPORT (v11.94 to v11.99): every activity type classified, with intensity, monotony, phase load, curves and fun facts per main sport.
DFA a1 (v11.72 / v11.73): drift on fixed recording thirds with eligibility gates, and clearer reasons when data is insufficient.

DOSSIER (v11.103): one authoritative DOSSIER.md in the data folder root (repository root on GitHub); web-chat uploads are copies of it. If yours lives elsewhere, the AI asks once and never moves or copies it.
MORE (v11.83 / v11.85 / v11.86 / v11.88 / v11.89 / v11.92): multi-night sleep context, decoupling detail, calendar end dates, live deload detection, one ACWR everywhere and fewer stream requests.

UPGRADE (one time): first move anything you added or changed inside section11/, and your own files named like Section 11 files, to custom/. Local sync and Manual export (Python 3.11 or newer): stop any timer you set up yourself, download the newest section11-YYYY.MM.DD.zip from https://github.com/CrankAddict/section-11/releases/latest, extract it to ~/Downloads/section11-bootstrap/, then from your data folder run python3 ~/Downloads/section11-bootstrap/section11/examples/sync.py --update and accept once (add --no-timer if you only export by hand; if your old timer passed your athlete ID and API key itself, run python3 section11/examples/sync.py --setup once). GitHub and On-demand sync: in GitHub's editor, replace .github/workflows/auto-sync.yml with the new template from your setup guide, keeping your cron line(s) and settings; if you use push-workout, replace push-workout.yml in the same commit; then run Sync once. Steps: examples/json-local-sync/SETUP.md (Initial Setup), examples/json-auto-sync/SETUP.md and examples/json-on-demand/SETUP.md (Updating an existing repository).
